- 2026-09-15T13:23:29.363Z — chose **Beyond spec: profile responses carry updated_at (null until first save, from the BOOPADA_NOW-aware clock); errors add an optional `field` and specific codes (unknown_currency, unknown_airport, invalid_interest, validation_error, invalid_json, invalid_body); lib/money.ts ships quotedToMoney/decimalToMinor/formatMoney for later features; /profile has per-interest checkboxes (data-testid profile-interest-<category>) and a profile-status line; biome now ignores .sofar and .mcp.json** over bare spec fields and a generic error code because Specific codes let the UI and tests tell failures apart; updated_at exercises the clock convention; the money helpers stop later sessions reinventing float-prone conversion; .mcp.json was unformatted at baseline and .sofar/.index is sofar-generated, both broke `bun run lint`.
- 2026-09-15T13:27:24.041Z — rule: **Never hard-delete traveller-made data: delete through softDelete() in lib/server/deletions.ts, and filter `deleted_at IS NULL` in every list, total and suggestion query.** — chose **App-wide soft delete: traveller-made rows get a nullable deleted_at; every deletion appends to a `deletions` log (entity_type, entity_id, deleted_at, restored_at); POST /api/undo restores the newest unrestored log entry (a stack, so repeated undos walk back), 409 nothing_to_undo when none. New deletable types register their table in SOFT_DELETE_TABLES in apps/web/lib/server/deletions.ts and go through softDelete().** over hard DELETE, confirmation dialogs, per-table undo, or an undo that only remembers a single last deletion because Operator decision for the whole app (never hard-delete, no "are you sure?", undo restores the most recent deletion).
